title: Dependency Audit Exceptions (app/web)
description: Web-app-scoped audit exceptions. Kept separate from the API's exceptions so an API-only exception (e.g. a transitive dep not present in the web tree) is not flagged stale when auditing app/web. Empty = no accepted web vulns.

exceptions.rationale: Advisory published 2026-09-18 (CVE-2026-93687, stack-exhaustion DoS via deeply nested brace patterns) affects braces through 3.0.3, the latest published version, so no patched release exists. In app/web braces is a dev-only transitive (package-lock dev:true, via micromatch/fast-glob in the build toolchain); it is never bundled into the shipped SPA and never receives untrusted input. 2026-10-06 re-check: npm audit fix --dry-run found no in-range lockfile update; its only reported remediation is a semver-major tailwindcss 4.3.3 update.
exceptions.compensating_control: braces only runs at build time on repository-controlled glob patterns inside CI/Vercel builds; no runtime or user-supplied pattern ever reaches it, so the DoS is not reachable in production.
exceptions.review_trigger: A braces release >3.0.3 fixing GHSA-vfj7-8cjw-p6xm is published; update the lockfile and remove this entry.
